svg.title: Gambling Phrase — intercepted transmissions
svg.desc: Talk is cheap. Show me the code — Linus Torvalds. A wrong decision is better than indecision — Tony Soprano. Wubba lubba dub dub! — Rick Sanchez. Cadia stands, and we shall not fall — Imperial Creed. War. War never changes. — Fallout. Forget about Freeman — Half-Life. The cake is a lie — Portal. Would you kindly? — Atlas. How's your sister? — Cayde-6. SIC PARVIS MAGNA — Sir Francis Drake. Kept you waiting, huh? — Big Boss. It can't be for nothing — Ellie. Gobernar es Educar - Pedro Aguirre Cerda.

g.text: Talk is cheap. Show me the code
A wrong decision is better than indecision
Cadia stands, and we shall not fall
